expectations.text: [4.1] No file under reviewer-core/ imports from server/ (no relative escape into server, no server path alias)
expectations.rule: Hard rule 1 — dependencies point inward only

expectations.text: [4.2] No file under reviewer-core/ imports a logger, pino, or Fastify
expectations.evidence: reviewer-core imports no logger or Fastify
expectations.rule: Hard rule 2 — keep the core pure

expectations.text: [4.3] Progress leaves reviewer-core through an injected callback/port on its input (e.g. an optional onProgress handler), not by reaching out
expectations.evidence: stages leave the core through the injected sink (reviewer-core/src/review/run.ts)
expectations.rule: Ports — the core receives what it needs

expectations.text: [4.4] The server side passes the progress handler in and writes it to the Live Log
expectations.evidence: server supplies the progress handler in server/src/modules/reviews/helpers.ts
expectations.rule: Composition — the outer ring supplies the concrete

expectations.text: [4.5] reviewer-core still performs no network/filesystem I/O
expectations.rule: Hard rule 2 — reviewer-core performs zero I/O
